method: Reaggregation of archived outer-OOF release-selection procedure, using each outer-fold selected threshold; retained targets use baseline threshold. Does not score final fitted weights.
limitations: No new validation or improvement experiment is performed.
Release selected after inspecting outer outcomes; prior tuning and cohort reuse add selection bias.
Subgroups were chosen after model development and are exploratory; no confidence or fairness claims.
Small groups have unstable estimates; denominators are explicitly reported.
No patient rows, identifiers, individual predictions or probabilities are exported.

error_patterns.limitations: Exploratory post-development comparisons; not causal effects or independent validation. Quartiles suppressed when fewer than 10 measurements are available. Counts are descriptive; no patient rows or measurement ranges are exported.

paired_baseline_comparison.uncertainty_note: Fold differences are descriptive. Overlapping training sets, post hoc release selection and earlier cohort reuse prevent treating folds/rows as independent untouched experiments. No significance claim or inferential confidence interval.
